items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was Leonard Feather, that was Leonard Feather.

ctx.x: That’s good. I wanted to ask you about your tour in ’54, was it? With Billy Holiday, and that was not a Jazz at the Philharmonic that was Leonard Feather.
That was Leonard Feather, that was Leonard Feather.
And that was called Jazz Club U.S.A.? That was his operation?
